name: Will selling without repairs affect my home's value?

mainEntity.name: Will selling without repairs affect my home's value?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, selling a home without repairs will generally affect its market value. Buyers will factor in the cost of necessary repairs and updates, often discounting their offer to cover these expenses, plus a buffer for unforeseen issues. The practical tradeoff is that while you avoid upfront repair costs, you exchange that for a likely lower sale price. The degree of impact depends on the extent of repairs needed; minor cosmetic issues may have less impact than major structural or system failures. Your agent can help you understand realistic pricing expectations for an as-is sale in your specific Miami-Dade or Broward County neighborhood.
acceptedAnswer.description: Selling without repairs usually lowers your home's market value, as buyers will deduct repair costs from their offer.
